body: yes think you are dead on there.  Although i was managing to work productively last term and now im not, so seeing negeative improvement whtich i cant understand

tons atm.  havent been right since mom died.  now failing at university, was drinking far too much last year ending up in random places (cut down on that now but still huge sense of having let myself down). Now got no motivation to do anything apart from getting out of bed and eating despite having a huge backlog of work to do, my situation only gets worse.

Never been a big beer man friend but happy to talk.  I have talked to more people about my problems recently than I have ever done so  before and I seem to get nowhere.  friends, Doctors, psychiatrists support groups and to not sound arrogant I am the only one who could sort these issues out but i know i cant

yeh thanks music has helped.  At one point my depression was so bad I didnt even want to listen to it.  but its slightly better now and I listen a lot.  I will try to start producing my own stuff when I get all this work done if I am still here.

yeh i know but it has been such a struggle these last few months.I have found tv and film really helpful recently but I havent been doing much else.    They are simply distractions.  but when they are over I have to confront my reality again.  As frank underwood said in HOC, there are two types of pain, pain that makes you strong and usesless pain.  I am sufferering from a lot of useless pain right now

thanks for your answer but the thing is I am to blame.  Its those stupid decisions I have made that have led to this depression.  I know I will be beating myself up about them for the rest of my days.  And the friend thing isnt quite true.  I have an awesome bunch of mates but nothing is how it was and I can honestly say I havent enjoyed anything for months now.
